lesson.title: 6.4 Left and Right
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
lesson.goal: Recognize left and right, and say that a place is on the left or on the right.
lesson.grammar_function: The bank is on the left. The pharmacy is on the right. Where is the bank? It is on the right.
lesson.prerequisite: 4.3 on and Where is it?; 6.1 bank and pharmacy.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say that a place is on the left or on the right.

items.text: The bank is on the left.
items.es: El banco está a la izquierda.
prefer: The bank is on the right.

items.text: The bank is on the right.
items.es: El banco está a la derecha.
prefer: The bank is on the left.

items.text: The pharmacy is on the right.
items.es: La farmacia está a la derecha.
prefer: The pharmacy is on the left.

items.text: The pharmacy is on the left.
items.es: La farmacia está a la izquierda.
prefer: The pharmacy is on the right.
